features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Prepare and cast divine spells from the cleric spell list using Wisdom.

features.name: Aura
features.summary: Project an alignment aura matching the cleric's deity when applicable.

features.name: Channel Energy
features.summary: Release positive or negative energy in a 30-foot burst to heal or harm. Affected creatures can make a Will save for half damage; the DC is 10 + half cleric level + Charisma modifier.
features.scaling: 1d6 at 1st level + 1d6 every 2 cleric levels thereafter

features.name: Deity
features.summary: Choose a deity whose alignment and portfolio determine the cleric's legal alignment, channel energy, and domains.

features.name: Alignment
features.summary: Choose an alignment within one step of the cleric's deity.

features.name: Channel Energy Type
features.summary: Channel positive or negative energy as determined by the cleric's alignment and deity.

features.name: First Domain
features.summary: Choose the first domain granted by the cleric's deity.

features.name: Second Domain
features.summary: Choose a different second domain granted by the cleric's deity.

features.name: 1st-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare one 1st-level spell from either selected domain in the dedicated domain slot.

features.name: Orisons
features.summary: Prepare 0-level cleric spells and cast prepared orisons without expending them.

features.name: Spontaneous Casting
features.summary: Convert prepared non-domain spells into cure spells when channeling positive energy or inflict spells when channeling negative energy.

features.name: 2nd-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare one 2nd-level spell from either selected domain in the dedicated domain slot.

features.name: 3rd-level Domain Spell Slot
features.summary: Prepare one 3rd-level spell from either selected domain in the dedicated domain slot.

features.name: 4th-level Domain Spell Slot
